{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the 'revenue' column is now numeric
print("Revenue dtype after parsing:", df['revenue'].dtype)

# Check if any revenue values are still suspicious (e.g., 999999.99)
print("Any revenue == 999999.99 after parsing?")
print(df['revenue'].eq(999999.99).any())"}
